what: Intra-day queue seq-scans the whole audit table
note: EXPLAIN ANALYZE on the exact predicate: 'Seq Scan on audit_logs (cost=0.00..1411.45) ... Rows Removed by Filter: 34790', 4.8 ms today. pg_indexes on audit_logs shows only pkey, (acted_as_role,acting_zone,created_at) and (entity_type,entity_id) — there is NO index on `action`. So every load of the Intra-day Queue reads the entire audit table. GET /intraday-updates as ZM returns 0 rows (no MANUAL_ZM_UPDATE rows exist yet), and passing ?limit=1&date=... changes nothing — the handler takes no query params, confirming a client cannot bound it. Cost is linear in total audit volume for the life of the deployment, so this is a growth defect, not a today defect.

what: Running backend is a partial build of a dirty tree
note: NOT a feature-backlog item — and a correction the whole sweep needs. The primer asserts 'build fingerprint beea7d2-dirty == git HEAD, so evidence from the running app is evidence about current source.' FALSE for scheduling, in BOTH directions. Newer than HEAD: the server answers UNSUPPORTED_ACTION, a string that does not exist in `git show HEAD:override.service.ts`. Older than the working tree: `dto/override-command.dto.ts` is UNTRACKED (no git log at all) and `batches.controller.ts` is modified-uncommitted, and the running server has neither — POST /batches/abc/override still 500s where the tree's toBigIntId guard answers 404. Consequence for every walker: a runtime 400/500/validation finding here dates a partially rebuilt dirty tree and MUST be re-read against working-tree source before it is filed as a gap.
